_meta.source: Six in-game Notice screenshots of the Archero 2 'Hotfix' Update Log, captured by XYIAN and transcribed 2026-09-06. Screens 1-4 duplicate the official patch-note text already folded in as v3.33.0; screens 5-6 carry the TAIL of the Gameplay Optimizations list (items 12-15) that the pasted text omitted.
_meta.confidence: high — transcribed verbatim from the in-game notice. Nothing inferred beyond what the notice states; where the notice is silent about what a named thing IS, that is recorded as unknown rather than guessed.

arena.mega_all_star_cup: Mega All-Star Cup is the higher tier alongside All-Star Cup, and the official notes ALSO call it 'Super All-Star Cup' — the same August 2026 notice uses 'Mega All-Star Cup' in its optimization list and 'Super All-Star Cup' in its bug-fix list for the same mode, so both names are official and interchangeable. Beyond receiving the same battle change as All-Star Cup, nothing is documented: what it is, how you enter it, what it rewards, and whether it is a separate mode or a higher tier are all unrecorded. Say so plainly and point at !suggest.
arena.super_all_star_cup_naming: 'Super All-Star Cup' and 'Mega All-Star Cup' are the SAME mode — both names appear in the official August 2026 notice. The 2026-08-23 preview called it 'Super Starlight Cup'. All three names mean one thing; answer from the Mega All-Star Cup entry.

custom_facts.text: The August 2026 hotfix fixed four issues: the Mystling Collection panel loaded too slowly when opened; the displayed count of duplicate skills was inconsistent between the skill selection screen and the battle screen; enemy names displayed incorrectly when entering Super All-Star Cup battles; and Plant Frenzy applied to incorrect targets.

Plant Frenzy is named in the August 2026 hotfix notes ONLY as a bug fix — it applied to incorrect targets and was corrected. What Plant Frenzy actually is, is not documented: do not assume it belongs to Magic Plant Defense or to any other mode. Say it is not documented and point at !suggest.
The in-game Update Log for the August 2026 hotfix ends with a 'Collaboration Event Preview' section that was not captured, so anything it contained is unrecorded.
